categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the development, production, and sales of asset digital monitoring and operation management systems centered on distributed optical fiber sensors. Key product lines include power facility asset monitoring systems, submarine cable asset monitoring systems, urban utility tunnel asset monitoring systems, and port traffic asset monitoring systems. These products serve asset-intensive industries such as power grids, offshore wind power, municipal utility tunnels, petrochemical, and port transportation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include distributed optical fiber sensing based on Raman, Brillouin, and Rayleigh scattering effects, embedded system optimization with FPGA and CPLD chips, AIoT asset operation systems, edge computing gateways, and intelligent terminals. The company employs advanced data acquisition, signal processing, AI algorithms, and cloud-edge collaborative computing. Production involves in-house assembly of core components and outsourcing standardized parts, with strict quality control and lean manufacturing practices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are large state-owned enterprises and industry leaders in power grids (e.g., State Grid, Huaneng Group), submarine cable manufacturers (e.g., Zhongtian Technology, Hengtong Optoelectronics), construction and infrastructure companies (e.g., China Railway, Gezhouba Group), and port operators (e.g., Hebei Port Group). The company’s products are widely applied across China in sectors including power transmission, offshore wind farms, urban infrastructure, petrochemical, and port logistics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with projects and customers distributed across various provinces and cities nationwide. There is no significant mention of overseas operations or markets in the report.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of sensing equipment and integrated asset monitoring systems. It also provides software platforms and intelligent operation management solutions, positioning itself as a system integrator and technology provider for asset-intensive industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in distributed optical fiber sensing technologies, AIoT integration, edge computing, and intelligent robotics for asset inspection. The company emphasizes R&D investment to enhance sensing accuracy, monitoring distance, data processing capabilities, and predictive maintenance algorithms. It actively expands into emerging markets such as port logistics, mining, and energy sectors, and develops modular, platform-based solutions with AI-driven analytics and digital twin technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of hardware products and integrated asset monitoring systems, including software licenses and service contracts. The company mainly uses a direct sales model supplemented by partnerships with agents, acquiring orders via bidding, competitive negotiation, and commercial negotiation. There is no indication of subscription or advertising-based revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic suppliers specializing in distributed optical fiber sensing-based asset digital monitoring and operation management systems. It holds a strong market position in power grid asset monitoring and offshore wind power sectors, with recognized brand influence and participation in national key projects. Competitors include other domestic and international firms in optical sensing and industrial IoT, but the company’s proprietary technologies and comprehensive solutions provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 182.47 million, a 40.06% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to macroeconomic challenges and project delays. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 67.57 million, reversing from prior profitability. R&D investment increased significantly to RMB 65.74 million, accounting for 36.03% of revenue. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 1.29 billion with a slight decrease year-over-year. The company is in a growth and investment phase, focusing on long-term competitiveness despite short-term losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly reliable, long-distance, distributed optical fiber sensing solutions with no blind spots, strong electromagnetic interference resistance, and intrinsic safety suitable for harsh industrial environments. Its integrated AIoT platform combines sensing, edge computing, and intelligent analytics to enable predictive maintenance and full lifecycle asset management. The modular, open, and scalable system architecture, combined with rich industry data and AI models, differentiates its products by enhancing operational efficiency, safety, and digital transformation capabilities for asset-intensive enterprises.
